messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — during the planned KMS rotation this morning + the tighter egress ACLs, a few GPU warm-pool nodes in eu-central and us-west failed keystore decrypts and stalled on join. Sample log from a node:
```
2026-07-12T05:11:22Z node-init ERROR keystore decrypt AccessDenied KMS:Decrypt
2026-07-12T05:11:24Z warmup WARN join attempt=3 -> backoff
```
Not full outage but reduces capacity runway.

noah: seeing same. Root cause looks like: rotation caused keystore-proxy to reissue sessions and clients used ephemeral ENIs that aren't covered by our new egress IP allowlist. ACL/IP model is brittle here.

devon: auditshipper also retried PUTs during the window, S3 PUTs spiked ~4x. If this persists it will show up on next invoice.

ops-bot: ALERT: gpu-warmup-fail-rate > 4% (10m). keystore-decrypt-p95 = 72s.

sophie: Proposed minimal-impact mitigation: pre-seed privatelink managed prefix-list (pl-xxxx) and add a short-lived route entry for keystore subnets that points to the prefix-list. This avoids having to enumerate ephemeral ENI IPs.

marta: agree. Also add a short TTL SG egress exception scoped to keystore subnet CIDR (10.244.8.0/22) limited to port 443 while we roll the prefix-list change.

noah: CLI snippet to add managed prefix-list route (dry-run):
```
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3 --destination-prefix-list-id pl-07e7c --network-interface-id eni-xxxx --dry-run
```
I'll open infra PR to create/seed the managed prefix-list and a revert timer.

devon: I'll flip auditshipper sampling to 25% for the next 30m to reduce PUT amplification while we apply changes. Cost note: temporary warm nodes ≈ $3k/day/region; sampling saves ≈ $2.6k/day. Keep window as short as possible.

infra-bot: ACTION: created infra PR platform/infra#1202 to preseed privatelink prefix-list + add canary that runs `kms:Decrypt` from a tagged ENI. PR includes ttl=1h and emergency-revert checkbox.

ops-bot: action: audit-sampler -> 25% (deploy id ds-1402). Applying SG egress temporary rule in staging for test.

sophie: After staging canary pass (10m), applying prefix-list route in prod now. Will monitor warm-pool joins.

marta: 22m after prefix-list + sampler: keystore decrypt p95 ~180ms, warm nodes joining. S3 PUTs trending down. Please add a pre-rotation canary step to the KMS runbook: "verify privatelink prefix-list resolution + run decrypt from tagged ENI".

noah: Agreed. Followups: 1) move allowlist to managed prefix-lists or service-names where supported 2) add automated pre-seed step to rotation workflow 3) add metric that detects fallback-to-NAT for keystore flows.

ops-bot: NOTE: monitoring window open 1h. If no regression, infra PR will auto-merge and SG TTL will expire.

marta: Thanks team — small incident but good catch. Adding postmortem checklist to rotation-runbook and linking PR. :thumbsup:
